title: Understanding MSE on Training Data
text: When you remove a feature from a model, think about how it affects the model's ability to fit the training data. Consider whether the model becomes simpler or more complex, and how that might impact the error on the training set.

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: Removing a feature can affect the bias and variance of the model. Consider how simplifying the model might increase bias but decrease variance, and how this tradeoff impacts the MSE on training data.
